assumptions: Upstream identity, frame hierarchy and camera intent remain authoritative outside the renderer.
limitations: Presentation coordinate transport only; no scientific, simulation, identity, history or camera authority.

fidelity.validity: Hierarchical presentation-space transport with camera-relative precision and explicit frame boundaries.
fidelity.resolution: Float64 active/adjacent-frame CPU coordinates with Float32 high/low GPU projection when needed.
fidelity.uncertainty: Bounded by upstream frame transforms and source-model accuracy.

assumptions: Entity identity and provenance are supplied by upstream authorities.
limitations: GPU-neutral presentation contract; no provenance promotion or simulation mutation.

fidelity.validity: Deterministic semantic packet composition independent of GPU backend and input order.
fidelity.resolution: Bounded packets with explicit geometry, material, picking and disposable resource claims.
fidelity.uncertainty: Rasterization may vary across compliant GPUs.

assumptions: Feature detection is environment truth only.
limitations: WebGPU is enhancement-only; direct-file always requires WebGL2.

fidelity.validity: Interchangeable backend selection without semantic-scene changes.

assumptions: Supported secure-context WebGPU device/context supplied externally.
limitations: Stage-1 meshes, points and curves with unlit presentation color; not yet product-primary.

fidelity.validity: Actual WebGPU commands over shared semantic scenes with bounded disposable resources.

assumptions: Packets contain camera-relative presentation geometry and external camera projection.
limitations: Mesh, point-batch and curve packet families currently supported; other declared families fail closed.

fidelity.validity: Deterministic compilation into strict V2X-13 WebGL2 frame consumer.
fidelity.resolution: Triangles, points and continuous curves with bounded resource lifecycle.

assumptions: V1X-04 source scene preserves canonical identity and labels noncanonical orbit geometry.
limitations: Body radius, color, lighting and orbit geometry are presentation-only; current orbital phase and metric distance are not claimed.

fidelity.validity: True-3D V1X-04 system representation converted to GPU-neutral Deep3D packets with identity preserved.
fidelity.resolution: Deterministic icosphere body LOD plus depth-aware orbit curves.
fidelity.uncertainty: Body/material/orbit display values are visual encodings.

assumptions: V1X-02 supplies stable identity-keyed bounded 3D presentation objects.
limitations: Identity-hashed coordinates and density field are presentation-only; density points are noncanonical, nonselectable and never discovery results.

fidelity.validity: Bounded Universe/Galaxy/Region/Neighborhood working sets are converted to camera-relative Deep3D points without materializing the universe.
fidelity.resolution: At most 64 semantic entities plus deterministic 512 desktop or 128 mobile density points.
fidelity.uncertainty: Positions and density are visual encodings, not physical measurements.

assumptions: Living runtime remains semantic-scale, camera-intent and selection authority.
limitations: Planet/surface/local/micro migration and WebGPU product-primary remain release-critical work.

fidelity.validity: Deep3D WebGL2/V2X-13 is visible SYSTEM renderer while Canvas retains only transparent interaction/accessibility hit targets.
fidelity.resolution: True-3D system to deterministic icosphere/curve scene.

assumptions: Living runtime remains semantic-scale, camera-intent and selection authority; Canvas computes interaction hit targets only.
limitations: GPU picking and cross-scale transition blending remain release-critical; WebGPU is not yet product-primary.

fidelity.validity: Deep3D WebGL2/V2X-13 is visible primary for Universe, Galaxy, Region and Neighborhood with real depth/parallax; Canvas is transparent interaction/accessibility overlay.
fidelity.resolution: Bounded V1X-02 semantic points plus noncanonical deterministic density cues.
fidelity.uncertainty: All synthesized positions and density remain presentation-only.
